title: Only lasted one year.
text: Only lasted one year.. I love that these are noiseless but had for one year and didn’t work when my child had an accident. Peed right through.

features: Breathable Mattress Protector, yet repels liquids through a revolutionary 100% waterproof membrane
Hypoallergenic: The Premium Mattress Protector is great for allergy, asthma, and eczema sufferers
Ultra-thin, breathable soft cotton terry surface that’s machine washable & durable

description: Shield your mattress from stains, fluids the natural way with our hypoallergenic, waterproof, and breathable mattress protector. Our advanced waterproof technology repels all fluids, while allowing air to pass through, giving you a fresh, clean, and healthy sleep.  The Miracle Membrane Topper is made of ultra-thin, soft, cotton terry, with a polyurethane barrier that is smooth and soundless: it won’t change the feel of your mattress. Because it prevents all liquids from getting through, the Handy Laundry Premium Mattress Protector will increase the life of your mattress. Just as important, it will protect your health. It blocks pollen and pet dander. It has an easy-on-and-off fit and design, and can be washed and tumble dried.  Safeguard your sleep with our premium queen mattress protector, and rest assured that our 10-year warranty means your mattress will last a long time.
